status.description: Status is the current status of the UserConfig.

UserConfig.title: User Config
UserConfig.description: UserConfig is the per-User configuration that is applied to all of the User's Workspaces regardless of their Space or Template. There is exactly one UserConfig per Octelium User and it is automatically created by the Cluster upon its first use.

dotfiles.description: Dotfiles is the User's personal dotfiles repository.

envVars.description: EnvVars is the list of the environment variables that are injected into every Workspace of the User.

tasks.description: Tasks is the list of the personal lifecycle tasks that are run in every Workspace of the User. They are run after the Template-level and the Space-level tasks.

preferredRegion.description: PreferredRegion is the name of the Octelium Region in which the User's Workspaces are preferably run. The Region must be enabled to host Workspaces.

url.description: URL is the HTTPS URL of the dotfiles git repository.

authentication.description: Authentication is set for the private dotfiles repositories.

branch.description: Branch is the branch of the dotfiles repository to be cloned. It defaults to the repository's default branch.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: Dotfiles
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: Dotfiles is a git repository containing the User's personal dotfiles. It is cloned into the Workspace at the beginning of the PREPARING phase and the first install script that is found in it is executed.

http.description: HTTP is the HTTP basic authentication.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: Authentication
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: Authentication is the credentials that are used to clone a private dotfiles repository.

username.description: Username is the basic authentication username.

password.description: Password is the basic authentication password.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: HTTP
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: HTTP is the HTTP basic authentication credentials.

fromUserSecret.description: FromUserSecret is the name of a UserSecret of the same User whose content is used as the password.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: Password
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: Password is the password, token or personal access token.

key.description: Key is the environment variable's name.

value.description: Value is the value provided directly as a string.

fromUserSecret.description: FromUserSecret is the name of a UserSecret of the same User whose content is used as the value.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: Env Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: EnvVar is an environment variable that is injected into every Workspace of the User.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the Octelium User who owns the UserConfig.

preferredRegionRef.description: PreferredRegionRef is the reference of the Region that the spec's preferredRegion resolves to.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..title: Status
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.UserConfig..description: Status is the current status of the UserConfig. It is managed by the Cluster and it is read-only.

name.description: Name is a unique name for the Task. It is used in the logs and in the failure reporting.

run.description: Run is the shell command that is executed by the Task.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the point of the Workspace's lifecycle at which the Task is run

envVars.description: EnvVars is the list of per-task environment variables.

workingDir.description: WorkingDir is the working directory of the Task. It defaults to the Workspace User's home directory.

isBackground.description: IsBackground starts the Task and lets the Workspace's initialization proceed without waiting for the Task to complete.

onFailure.title: On Failure
onFailure.description: OnFailure is the behavior of the Cluster when the Task fails

runAsRoot.description: RunAsRoot runs the Task as `root` instead of as the Workspace User.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Task
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Task is a command that is run at a defined point of the Workspace's lifecycle.

key.description: Key is the environment variable's name.

value.description: Value is the environment variable's value.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Env Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: EnvVar is a per-task environment variable which is merged with the Workspace-level environment variables.

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
